# INHERIT v3 Root Schema

Root entry point for an INHERIT v3 estate data interchange document. Contains a single estate and arrays of all entity types

Source: [`v3/schema.json`](../../v3/schema.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/schema.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | const `https://openinherit.org/v3/schema.json` | | Schema identifier — declares this as an INHERIT v3 document. Standard JSON Schema keyword |
| `@context` | `string` (uri) or `object` | | JSON-LD context URI. When present, makes this document self-describing linked data |
| `@type` | `string` | | JSON-LD type, e.g. InheritDocument |
| `schemaVersion` | `string` | yes | Semver version of the INHERIT schema this document was created against. Enables consumers to detect compatibility and handle graceful degradation |
| `exportedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | Timestamp when this document was exported from the producing system |
| `exportedBy` | `object` | | The person who exported or prepared this document |
| `generator` | `object` | | The software that generated this INHERIT document |
| `documentVersion` | `integer` | | Sequential version number for this document. Incremented each time the document is substantively modified. Version 1 is the first version |
| `versionedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When this version of the document was created. Courts and regulators care about when changes were made, not just which version number |
| `previousVersionId` | `string` or `null` (uuid) | | Reference to the document ID of the previous version. Creates a linked list of document versions enabling version chain traversal. Null for the first version |
| `changeDescription` | `string` | | Human-readable summary of what changed in this version. Like a commit message for the document |
| `estate` | [Estate](estate.md) | yes | The single estate record for this document |
| `people` | array of [Person](person.md) | yes | All people involved in the estate — testator, beneficiaries, executors, witnesses, guardians, etc |
| `kinships` | array of [Kinship](kinship.md) | | Familial bonds between people in the estate. Essential for intestacy calculations |
| `relationships` | array of [Relationship](relationship.md) | | Spousal and partnership relationships. Determines marital property rights and surviving spouse claims |
| `properties` | array of [Property](property.md) | | Real estate owned or partly owned by the testator |
| `assets` | array of [Asset](asset.md) | | Non-property assets — financial accounts, personal property, vehicles, digital assets, etc |
| `assetCollections` | array of [Asset Collection](asset-collection.md) | | Named groups of related assets — collections (model railways, art, wine, etc.) that have collective significance and value |
| `liabilities` | array of [Liability](liability.md) | | Debts and financial obligations of the estate, including cultural obligations (mahr, ketubah debt) |
| `bequests` | array of [Bequest](bequest.md) | | Dispositions of property or money in the will |
| `trusts` | array of [Trust](trust.md) | | Trusts — testamentary or inter vivos — associated with the estate |
| `executors` | array of [Executor](executor.md) | | Persons appointed to administer the estate |
| `guardians` | array of [Guardian](guardian.md) | | Guardian appointments for minor children |
| `wishes` | array of [Wish](wish.md) | | Non-binding (or culturally binding) wishes — funeral, letters, pet care, digital estate |
| `documents` | array of [Document](document.md) | | Documents associated with the estate — wills, codicils, trust deeds, certificates |
| `nonprobateTransfers` | array of [Nonprobate Transfer](nonprobate-transfer.md) | | Assets that pass outside the probate estate — JTWROS, TOD deeds, beneficiary designations |
| `proxyAuthorisations` | array of [Proxy Authorisation](proxy-authorisation.md) | | Authorisations for proxies to act on behalf of the testator |
| `powersOfAppointment` | array of [Power of Appointment](power-of-appointment.md) | | Powers of appointment — testamentary authority granted to someone to decide distribution |
| `valuations` | array of [Valuation](valuation.md) | | Valuations of assets, properties, and collections. Multiple valuations per entity are supported — owner estimates, professional valuations, AI estimates, dealer offers |
| `lifetimeTransfers` | array of [Lifetime Transfer](lifetime-transfer.md) | | Gifts and transfers made during the testator's lifetime. Critical for inheritance tax calculations — UK 7-year rule, US unified gift/estate tax, etc |
| `organisations` | array of [Organisation](organisation.md) | | Organisations that interact with the estate — legal firms, financial institutions, charities, dealers, funeral providers, employers, government bodies, and others |
| `spaces` | array of [Space](space.md) | | Spaces within properties — rooms, outbuildings, storage areas, and outdoor zones where assets are located |
| `dataProvenance` | one of `manual_entry`, `ai_extracted`, `ocr_scanned`, `imported`, `migrated`, `system_generated` | | How this document was originally created. Indicates the primary method of data entry for the document as a whole — individual entities may have their own per-field provenance via confidenceScores |
| `partialDocument` | `boolean` | | Signals that this is an intentionally incomplete document. Enables incremental onboarding — platforms can import partially completed estate plans without triggering validation errors for missing fields |
| `bundleType` | one of `document`, `collection`, `transaction` | | The type of INHERIT bundle — indicates whether this is a complete document, a subset, or a transactional batch |
| `importSources` | array of [ImportSource](#def-ImportSource) | | Systems from which data was imported into this document. Enables audit trail and source tracking |
| `conformance` | [Conformance](#def-Conformance) | | Machine-readable conformance certificate — records the validation level, schema version, completeness score, and provenance summary at time of validation |
| `extensions` | array of `object` | | Extension schemas applied to this document. Each entry declares the extension's identity, version, scope, and data block name |
| `insurancePolicies` | array of [InsurancePolicy](insurance-policy.md) | | Insurance policies associated with the estate — life, home, health, motor, travel, pet, and professional indemnity |
| `pets` | array of [Pet](pet.md) | | Pets requiring care arrangements |
| `integrity` | `object` | | JWS-based tamper evidence for the INHERIT document |
| `auditLog` | array of [Audit Event](common/audit-event.md) | | Formal audit trail of actions taken on this document. Records who changed what, when, and why. Uses person ID references for GDPR data minimisation. Entries may be redacted under Article 17(3)(e) without breaking the log structure. Retention aligns with the estate document lifecycle |
| `applicationState` | `object` | | Application-specific state that is NOT part of the INHERIT interchange standard. Implementations may use these fields internally but should not expect other systems to populate or consume them. Implementations may add custom fields beyond those listed here |
| `referentialIntegrity` | array of [IntegrityConstraint](#def-IntegrityConstraint) | | Machine-readable cross-reference integrity constraints. Defined in the schema, not in individual documents. Validators read these rules and check that every referenced ID exists in the target array |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

| `entityCounts` | `object` | | Count of entities per type at time of validation |
| `provenanceSummary` | `object` | | Count of entities by data provenance source |
| `warnings` | array of `string` | | Validation warnings — non-blocking issues that may need attention |
| `validationEndpoint` | `string` (uri) | | URL of the validation service that produced this conformance certificate |

<a id="def-IntegrityConstraint"></a>

### IntegrityConstraint

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | [IntegrityPath](#def-IntegrityPath) | yes | The field containing the reference (source) |
| `references` | [IntegrityPath](#def-IntegrityPath) | yes | The target array + id field that must contain the referenced value |
| `required` | `boolean` | | If true, a broken reference is always an error. If false, the field may reference multiple target arrays (grouped by field path) |
| `kind` | one of `existence`, `acyclic` | | The constraint's semantics. 'existence' (the default when absent, and the shape of every constraint before this keyword existed) requires the referenced id to be present in the target array. 'acyclic' additionally requires that following the reference repeatedly terminates — no node reachable from itself — within maxDepth hops |
| `maxDepth` | `integer` | | For kind 'acyclic': the maximum number of hops a containment chain may have before it is rejected as unreasonably deep. A chain longer than this fails with INHERIT_DEPTH_EXCEEDED even if it is acyclic |
| `code` | `string` | yes | Machine-readable error code from the INHERIT error vocabulary |
| `errorMessage` | `string` | yes | Human-readable description of the constraint violation |

<a id="def-IntegrityPath"></a>

### IntegrityPath

A path expression for referential integrity constraints. Supports camelCase field paths and x-inherit-* extension block paths

Type: `string`
